## 1. The reader's question

**Asked:** Not asked: the author asked Claude to write out all the cards on the states of Data Hub, to review them together.

**Answer:** Claude's suggestion, from the places that meet the reader (no Message names it yet: "A Resource was withdrawn" (MSG-RES-06) names K5.1 What a resource is (DEC-LR-29), which does not explain withdrawing, and deprecating sends no Message): "This Resource says deprecated. Are the figures in my report wrong now?", from a colleague from credit while building a report. Whether colleagues say it this way is for the test reader.

**In the card:** Why now, the quote and the situation.

## 2. What went wrong

**Asked:** Not asked: drafted by Claude.

**Answer:** Claude's suggestion, from FR-SR-50 (deprecated: marked by the Owner Unit or the Data Team, with why and what to use instead; it hides nothing and blocks nothing and can be taken away), DEC-SR-26 (withdrawn, not deleted: only the Data Team and the Owner Unit still see it; it keeps its Collection, Confirmations and Log and comes back as it was), DEC-DH-67 (what reads a withdrawn Resource is Broken) and MSG-RES-06: the credit team marks Weekly lead volume deprecated, with Leads per week to use instead; a month later the Data Team stops offering it to Data Hub and it is withdrawn. Expected misconceptions, none heard yet: a deprecated Resource stops working; Data Hub moves my Lens for me; a withdrawn Resource is deleted; Data Hub hides Resources nobody uses; I may keep building on a deprecated one as it still works.

**In the card:** the situation of Why now; Core idea, "At Immoscoop"; the wrong answers of the three questions.

## 3. The aha

**Asked:** Not asked: drafted by Claude.

**Answer:** Claude's suggestion: deprecated still works but should no longer be built on, so move to what its mark names; withdrawn is gone for everyone but its Owner Unit and the Data Team, and what reads it stops until it comes back.

**In the card:** Core idea, the rule.

## 5. Never again, ask first

**Asked:** Not asked: drafted by Claude.

**Answer:** Claude's suggestion: never build something new on a deprecated Resource; ask first "What does the mark say to use instead?". Tested out loud: either answer leads to a next step, not to a wrong one.

**In the card:** You can now, the first question; a wrong answer.

## The ladder

1. **Story:** a shop that puts up "closing at the end of the month, we moved to the next street", and later closes its door.
2. **Structure:** a Resource → deprecated (works, warns, names what to use instead) → withdrawn (gone for most, what reads it Broken, back as it was if it returns).
3. **Data Hub:** the mark deprecated on the page of a Resource and wherever it is used, and the Message that it was withdrawn.

The card has no See it: the third rung is a screen of Data Hub, not a chart. Apply leads there instead. The first two rungs are pictures (Figma work); the card has no place for them yet.

## Who brought what

The author asked Claude to write out all the cards on the states of Data Hub, without an anchor, and reviews them together. Claude brought everything in the card, from the rules of Data Hub and its Messages. A "yes" to a suggestion weighs less than the author's own words, so the fact check and the test reader carry more weight here than usual.

The author reviewed the cards together: "All good", and asked Claude to check the open facts itself. Checked by Claude in the code on 2026-11-14, at the author's request: the mark deprecated shows on the page of the Resource, on the page of its Collection, in its folder and in the panel, and Claude names it, but not yet on the Lenses and Reports built on it (FR-SR-50 says they show it when they are built); the card says so. The author approved naming this card under "A Resource was withdrawn" (DEC-LR-37), so it is linked from the web app.
